title: storysync.config.json
description: Project settings for Storysync. Every setting can also come from a flag or an environment variable; the order is flag, environment variable, this file, default.

url.description: The running Storybook (dev server). Default http://localhost:6006. Env: STORYSYNC_STORYBOOK_URL. Flag: --storybook.

framework.description: The Storybook framework, when detection from .storybook/main gets it wrong.

source.description: Where design tokens are read from. Detected when left out. Flag: --source.

include.description: Component names or IDs to work with. All when left out. Flag: --components.

maxCombinations.description: Most variant combinations per component before capping. Default 256. Flag: --max-combinations.

fileKey.description: The Figma file to sync with: the part of its URL after /design/. Env: STORYSYNC_FIGMA_FILE_KEY. Flag: --file-key.
